item.title: Trump to address nation about Iran as he signals war could end within weeks
item.summary: Trump will deliver a primetime address on the Iran conflict, and the White House signaled an “important update" as the war enters a critical stage.

item.title: Reporter kidnapped in Baghdad known for pursuing gutsy, low-budget assignments while living ‘frugal existence’
item.summary: Award-winning American journalist Shelly Kittleson has been kidnapped in Iraq after brushing off threats that coincided with her coverage.

item.title: Trump admonishes reporter for interrupting his answer on Iran operations: 'Lot of problems with you'
item.summary: President Donald Trump remarked he's "had a lot of problems" with NewsNation correspondent Libbey Dean after she interrupted him during a press conference.

item.title: Fox News Poll: Broad anxiety about AI doesn’t extend to jobs
item.summary: A new poll finds voter concern about AI has risen to 66%, while nearly two-thirds are uncomfortable with military use of autonomous weapons systems.

item.title: Artemis II vs Apollo: Why this mission loops the moon but doesn't land
item.summary: NASA's Artemis II crew prepares for a historic lunar flyby aboard the Orion spacecraft and SLS rocket, traveling farther into space than any humans since Apollo.

item.title: Artemis II launches astronauts around the moon in first deep space mission since Apollo
item.summary: NASA's Artemis II crew launched on the first crewed lunar mission in over 50 years, sending four astronauts around the moon aboard the Orion spacecraft.

item.title: Jalen Brunson's sister blasts ESPN after Stephen A Smith Knicks rant: 'Utterly ridiculous'
item.summary: Jalen Brunson's sister, Erica, blasted ESPN on X after Stephen A. Smith ranted about the Knicks and Josh Hart, calling the coverage "utterly ridiculous."

item.title: Stephen A Smith regrets voting for Kamala Harris, says he lost faith in Democrats
item.summary: Stephen A. Smith said that he regrets voting for former Vice President Kamala Harris, initially believing she could work across the aisle before concluding Democrats still did not understand why they lost.

item.title: Ilhan Omar admits Dems are responsible for DHS shutdown
item.summary: Rep. Ilhan Omar said Democrats withheld support for a Homeland Security funding bill unless immigration enforcement reforms were included while speaking at a town hall in Minnesota.

item.title: Sauer cites ‘striking’ figures on secretive birth tourism in high-stakes SCOTUS case
item.summary: Trump's executive order seeks to reinterpret the 14th Amendment to deny citizenship to children of illegal immigrants. The Supreme Court heard oral arguments Wednesday.
